task_instance: Harden a small sample Anima/Figma design-to-code pipeline by applying the skill's core server-side-only token enforcement (Step 2: src/anima/safety.ts validateEnvironment guard) plus the checklist's local secret hardening (.env gitignored and chmod 600, no tokens embedded in generated code), then verify the guard fail-closes when ANIMA_TOKEN or FIGMA_TOKEN are missing and when the SDK is imported in a browser-like context.
blocker_detail: The skill's other two Output items are account-bound and were not exercised but did not block the core deliverable: the Figma minimal-scope token requires creating a real Personal Access Token on a design-tool account, and the secret-manager loader (secrets.ts) targets a cloud secret manager SDK that needs a cloud project and credentials; both are forbidden by the safety rules (no credentials/accounts). The example preflight script referenced by the skill (scripts/anima-preflight.mjs) is not bundled next to SKILL.md, so it was not run; the verified core enforcement does not depend on it.
